data.name: Adventure.Ui.HubSubtitle
data.value: Make your choices, roll the dice and live with what follows.

data.name: Adventure.Ui.HubDescription
data.value: Make your choices, roll the dice and carry the consequences. Every tale shares your character, inventory and encounters.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Act.act-4
data.value: Act IV · The Badge Has Teeth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rain-office.Body
data.value: Rain writes crooked lines down the office glass. The city outside is all wet pavement, tired neon and the kind of traffic that never quite stops. At twelve seventeen, Evelyn Vane walks in without an appointment. Her husband, Arthur Vane, left the Hotel Mirabelle yesterday evening and never came home. The police logged it as a rich man taking a private night away. Evelyn does not believe them. Neither does the envelope of cash she sets on your desk.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-timeline
data.value: Start with the timeline. Make her account precise.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-ivory-room
data.value: Ask why the Ivory Room name is written on the back of Arthur's hotel card.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.take-case
data.value: Take the case and go straight to the Hotel Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.timeline-clean.Body
data.value: Evelyn answers in the clipped rhythm of someone who has rehearsed the story because nobody official listened the first time. Arthur checked into room 306 at 6:42 p.m. He called home at 8:03. A hotel porter saw him return from the street at 9:11. At 9:28, the switchboard recorded an outgoing connection from his room. After that, seventeen minutes are missing from the hotel's internal log. Evelyn never mentions those seventeen minutes until you make her walk through the sequence twice.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.timeline-to-hotel
data.value: Go to the Mirabelle before the night staff changes.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.timeline-frayed.Body
data.value: The sequence refuses to settle. Evelyn remembers the call, the hotel, the rain, and the fact that Arthur sounded afraid, but exact times slide away from her. Whether that is grief, exhaustion or concealment is impossible to tell tonight. You still get one useful fact: room 306, Hotel Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.frayed-to-hotel
data.value: Work with what you have. Go to the Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.crooked-crown.Body
data.value: Rain needles the windows of the Crooked Crown and turns the road outside into black glass. Mara Vey, the innkeeper, sets a sealed letter beside your cup without asking whether you want it. "A stranger paid well to make sure this reached you." The wax is black. The mark pressed into it is a stag with one antler broken away.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.open-letter
data.value: Break the seal and read the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.inspect-seal
data.value: Inspect the seal before touching the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.question-keeper
data.value: Watch Mara carefully and ask who delivered it.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.greyhaven-road.Body
data.value: By the time the road falls toward Greyhaven, the sea has disappeared behind a wall of pearl-grey fog. Gulls wheel above fields you can no longer see, and every fence post wears a crust of salt. You came for a quiet night's shelter. The village below looks as though it has forgotten how to offer one.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.fog-signs.Body
data.value: The fog is wrong. Wind bends the grass inland, but the bank over Greyhaven barely shifts. Beneath the ordinary smell of brine sits something colder: iron, old stone and extinguished candles. Whatever waits below is not only weather.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.descend-aware
data.value: Keep that in mind and enter the village.

data.name: Adventure.Ui.EmptyBoard
data.value: No evidence pinned yet. The board grows as the investigation uncovers people, places, evidence, leads and theories.

data.name: Adventure.Ui.BoardHelp
data.value: Drag a selected card to rearrange the investigation. Connections follow it live. Right-click a card for board actions. FIT focuses known evidence; FRAME shows the complete workspace boundary.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-name.Body
data.value: Evelyn's expression changes before her answer does. The Ivory Room is not a hotel bar. It is a private gaming room above the Monarch Casino, technically invitation-only and practically owned by Vincent Moretti. Arthur had sworn he stopped going there months ago. Evelyn found the name on his hotel card this morning, written in his own hand.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.client-closes.Body
data.value: For half a second Evelyn looks at the card instead of you. Then she says the Ivory Room means nothing to her. It is a bad lie, but not a careless one. Push harder now and she may walk. Let it sit and the lie becomes something you can return to later.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hotel-lobby.Body
data.value: The Hotel Mirabelle was built for people who wanted marble to make their sins look expensive. At one in the morning, the lobby is quiet enough to hear the rain ticking against the brass revolving door. The night clerk recognizes Arthur Vane's name immediately, then tries very hard not to.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.clerk-cooperates.Body
data.value: The clerk's resistance gives way all at once. Arthur Vane checked in alone. Nobody signed the visitor book for 306. The room key was never returned, yet housekeeping found the door unlocked at dawn. The clerk produces the duplicate key from beneath the desk and insists you never got it from him.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.switchboard-desk.Body
data.value: The clerk keeps glancing toward the switchboard alcove. The operator has stepped away, leaving the night's call sheet under a glass paperweight. Room 306 appears twice. The second entry has been cut out with a razor so cleanly that the missing strip looks deliberate rather than damaged.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.service-hall.Body
data.value: The front desk closes ranks. Hotels have two maps, though: the one guests see and the one staff use. A service corridor behind the elevators runs past linen storage, maintenance stairs and, eventually, the third floor. The lock on the stair door is old but not decorative.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-arrives.Body
data.value: The lock wins the argument. Before you can decide whether to try again, a voice behind you says your name. Detective Elias Hale stands under the corridor's weak service light with his coat still wet from outside. He says Vane is not a police matter. Then he asks what Evelyn told you. The order of those two statements matters.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-slip.Body
data.value: Hale's eyes move toward the elevator when you mention Vane, then to the third-floor indicator before you ever say the room number. He catches himself a second too late. When you ask how he knows 306, his expression turns flat. 'Everybody knows now,' he says. Nobody in the lobby did.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-lets-pass.Body
data.value: Hale does not answer the question. He steps aside instead, the gesture too deliberate to be kindness. 'Five minutes,' he says. 'Then you were never on this floor.' Whether he is helping you, controlling the scene or waiting to see what you find remains open.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.room-306.Body
data.value: The room has been cleaned badly rather than carefully. One chair is wrong for the table. A dark crescent remains in the carpet where somebody scrubbed until the fibers changed color. A brass cufflink sits beneath the radiator. Half a photograph is trapped behind the wastebasket. There is no body, no suitcase and no sign that Arthur Vane packed before leaving.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cufflink-detail.Body
data.value: The cufflink is expensive, but the interesting part is the bent stem. It was torn sideways under force. The cleaned stain sits exactly where someone standing near the radiator would have fallen or been driven down. Whatever happened here was physical. Whoever cleaned the room missed the one object that rolled out of sight.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photo-detail.Body
data.value: The photograph shows Arthur Vane outside the Ivory Room beside Vincent Moretti. A third person has been torn away so precisely that only one gloved hand remains on Vane's shoulder. The picture is old enough to contradict Evelyn's claim that Arthur stopped visiting months ago, but recent enough that the Monarch's winter marquee is visible behind them.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.phone-detail.Body
data.value: The room phone has been opened and reassembled. One screw is fresh. Inside, the line pair carries a tiny bridge clip that would let someone monitor or reroute a call from the service junction. This was not done by a guest improvising with a pocketknife. Somebody with access prepared the room before Vane arrived.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.first-room-conclusion.Body
data.value: By the time you leave room 306, this is no longer a simple disappearance. Someone prepared the room, someone cleaned it, and at least one person with institutional access wants the timeline softened. The case board has its first real shape now: Vane, the Mirabelle, the Ivory Room, Hale, the erased call and the objects the cleaner missed. None of it proves who took Arthur Vane. It proves only that several people need you to believe nothing happened.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.foundation-checkpoint.Body
data.value: The rain is still falling when you step back into the street. The next move can point toward the Ivory Room, the police department, Evelyn Vane's omissions or the missing seventeen minutes. Those routes belong to the next content expansion; the campaign foundation, custom roster and live investigation board are now in place.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ivory-to-hotel
data.value: Pocket the name. Start where Arthur was last seen: the Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.close-to-hotel
data.value: Let the lie stand for now. Go to the Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.talk-clerk
data.value: Convince the night clerk that helping you is safer than obstructing you.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.watch-lobby
data.value: Stay quiet and watch what the staff are trying not to look at.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.bribe-clerk
data.value: Put five coins on the desk and ask for room 306 without another word.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.take-key
data.value: Take the duplicate key and go upstairs.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.copy-log
data.value: Copy the surviving entries and head upstairs.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.pick-service-lock
data.value: Work the service-door lock without drawing attention.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.force-service-door
data.value: Put your shoulder into it and accept the noise.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.answer-hale
data.value: Give him nothing useful and ask why he is here.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.hale-pass-room
data.value: Take the five minutes. Enter room 306.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.study-cufflink
data.value: Examine the brass cufflink and the cleaned stain together.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.study-photo
data.value: Work out what is missing from the torn photograph.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.study-phone
data.value: Trace the telephone cable and compare it with the switchboard story.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.cufflink-conclude
data.value: Pin the cufflink to the board and reconsider the room.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.photo-conclude
data.value: Keep the photograph. The casino is now part of the case.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.phone-conclude
data.value: The missing call was engineered. Add it to the board.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.village-gate.Body
data.value: Greyhaven is built in layers down the cliff: slate roofs, narrow stairs, black timber and lamps already burning though dusk is an hour away. A weathered board beside the road reads GREYHAVEN — KEEP THE LIGHT. Someone has carved beneath it: IF THE BELL CALLS, DO NOT ANSWER.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.harbor-dusk.Body
data.value: Fishing boats knock gently against the quay. Too many are tied up for a working evening. A young woman in a waxed coat is pinning another missing notice to a piling. She looks at every face that passes, as though comparing it against someone she has memorized.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bent-anchor.Body
data.value: The Bent Anchor is warm, crowded and almost silent. Conversations soften when the door opens, then slowly resume when everyone decides you are merely a stranger. Behind the bar, Mara Holt dries the same glass three times while watching you through its rim.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.room-tension.Body
data.value: Three details emerge once you stop looking for conversation and start looking for avoidance: nobody sits near the windows, every table falls quiet when the sea is mentioned, and a brass handbell behind the bar has been wrapped tightly in cloth. Mara notices you noticing it.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.mara-welcome.Title
data.value: A Room with the Shutters Closed

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.mara-welcome.Body
data.value: Mara takes your coins, pushes a bowl of fish stew across the bar and gives you a room key. 'Shutters stay closed after midnight,' she says. 'If you hear anything from the water, it is wind. If it sounds like a bell, it is still wind.' Her tone makes clear that Greyhaven has agreed on this lie together.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.mara-rumor.Body
data.value: Mara's jaw tightens. Three villagers have disappeared in eight days. One walked from his bed. One vanished from a boat tied to the quay. The third was Nell Rook's brother, Tomas. Each disappearance followed the sound of a bell somewhere beyond the breakwater. 'There is no bell out there,' Mara finishes. 'Not anymore.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.nell-enters.Body
data.value: The young woman from the harbor enters carrying rain with her. Nell Rook is tired enough to sway when she stops walking, but anger keeps her upright. She sees the stranger asking questions, sees Mara's expression, and comes straight over. 'If you're another person telling us Tomas ran away, save your breath.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.meet-nell.Body
data.value: Tomas heard the bell before anyone else admitted hearing it. He said it was coming from beneath the old lighthouse, not from the tower. On the night he vanished he left a note: THE NAMES ARE WRONG. Nell has searched the cliff paths every day since.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-note.Body
data.value: Nell unfolds a damp scrap of paper. Tomas wrote four surnames beneath his warning, all old Greyhaven families. One has been crossed out so violently the paper tore. On the back is a crude drawing of a ship's bell and a small chapel window.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.rowan-arrives.Body
data.value: A broad-shouldered priest in a salt-stained black coat pauses beside your table. Father Rowan has the look of a man who has not slept because sleep would require surrender. 'If you're involving yourself,' he says, 'come to Saint Orra's tomorrow. There are records Tomas was reading. I would rather someone sensible see them before the village decides to burn them.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.rowan-symbol.Body
data.value: Rowan recognizes the window shape immediately. Saint Orra's current chapel has no such window, but the older foundation beneath it did. That lower chapel was sealed after the Saint Marrow wreck seventy years ago. Rowan stops there, suddenly aware he has said more than he intended.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.first-bell.Body
data.value: At 11:47, every conversation in the Bent Anchor dies at once. Far beyond the shuttered windows comes a single low note. It is too deep to be a handbell and too clear to be a buoy. Glass trembles on the shelves. Nell closes her eyes. Mara whispers, 'Don't count them.' A second toll rolls in through the walls.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bell-window.Title
data.value: A Light in the Dead Tower

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bell-window.Body
data.value: Fog fills the street like pale smoke. Above the roofs, the abandoned lighthouse should be black. Instead a weak blue-white light circles once behind its cracked lantern glass and vanishes. Nobody else in the room comes to the window.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bell-listen.Body
data.value: You listen past the bell itself. Beneath it is a second sound: many voices speaking at once, too low to distinguish. One syllable repeats with each toll. It might be a name. It might be many names layered together.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.night-after-bell.Body
data.value: The bell stops after seven tolls. Nobody comments on the number. Chairs scrape, doors close and the Bent Anchor empties faster than seems possible. In your room, seawater beads along the inside of the window frame despite the shutters being dry.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.salt-trace.Body
data.value: The droplets contain fine black ash. Arcane residue clings to it in a repeating pattern, not a spell exactly but the memory of one. Something is using a ritual structure to carry sound through water and stone.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.morning-greyhaven.Body
data.value: Morning brings no sunlight, only a brighter shade of fog. Greyhaven offers several trails at once: Tomas's room, Father Rowan's archives, the dead lighthouse and Captain Varro's harbor warehouse. Somewhere among them is the reason the bell has started calling names.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.leave-harbor
data.value: Give her space and continue to the inn.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.ask-room
data.value: Ask Mara for a room and something hot.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.ask-bell
data.value: Ask why the handbell is wrapped.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.sit-fire
data.value: Take the stew and watch the room.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.promise-help
data.value: Tell Nell you will listen, not judge.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.stay-out
data.value: Tell her this is not your business.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.return-note
data.value: Return the note and agree to investigate.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.religious-symbol
data.value: Ask about the chapel symbol on Tomas's note.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.open-shutters
data.value: Open the shutters and look toward the sea.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.mark-light
data.value: Remember exactly where the light appeared.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.inspect-water
data.value: Inspect the salt water at the window.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.begin-investigation
data.value: Start with the village and follow what you find.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.forged-seal.Body
data.value: The wax itself is ordinary, but the impression is wrong. Tiny doubled lines ring the broken antler — the telltale edge of a cast copy. Whoever sent this wanted the symbol recognized without owning the original signet.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.seal-uncertain.Body
data.value: You turn the seal beneath the lamplight, but the rainlight and soot make every scratch look meaningful. Mara keeps polishing the same glass. Whatever she knows, she has decided to make you earn it.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.keeper-truth.Body
data.value: Mara's expression tightens. "Grey travelling coat. Mud to the knees. Silver tack on the horse — expensive. He kept looking toward the old north road." She lowers her voice. "And he was afraid. Not of me. Of being followed."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.keeper-guarded.Body
data.value: "Traveller. Hood up. Paid in silver." Mara delivers the answer too quickly. Whether from fear or irritation, she has decided that is all you are getting tonight.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.letter-opened.Body
data.value: The letter contains only three lines: NORTH ROAD. SAINT ORRA'S BRIDGE. BEFORE MIDNIGHT. COME ALONE IF YOU WANT THE MISSING NAMES. Beneath the words is a charcoal sketch of the broken-antler stag.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.seal-residue.Body
data.value: There is no spell on the letter, but the wax carries a faint residue like cold pine needles after rain. It is too old to belong to the courier. The symbol itself has been used around magic before.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.remembered-mark.Body
data.value: You remember a censored court record: the Black Stag was the name of a courier network that once moved testimony too dangerous to enter the royal courts openly. The network supposedly died twenty years ago. The symbol on the page was older than the network by centuries.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.north-road.Body
data.value: The bridge rises from the fog like a broken rib. A hooded courier waits beside the parapet. Before either of you can speak, boots scrape stone behind you. A hunter in a dark coat blocks the road back, one hand already on his sword.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hunter-disarmed.Body
data.value: The hunter commits too early. You catch his wrist, turn the strike, and send the sword spinning across wet stone. The courier laughs once in disbelief, then thrusts a leather packet toward you.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hunter-defeated.Body
data.value: The exchange is fast and ugly, but you force the hunter back far enough for the courier to reach you. "No time," she says. "Take this. If I fall, don't give it to anyone wearing a crown."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.lower-ledge.Body
data.value: You drop beneath the parapet as steel flashes overhead. The courier follows, landing badly but keeping hold of a leather packet. A maintenance door waits ten paces away above a black river.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hunter-hesitates.Body
data.value: The hunter's grip loosens by a fraction. "You don't know what she's carrying." The courier answers first: "Names. Judges, officers, merchants. Everyone who bought a place in the disappearances."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hunter-warning.Body
data.value: "Because half the names are bait," the hunter says. "The real list is shorter. Someone wants a purge, not justice." The courier says nothing, which is answer enough.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.wounded-escape.Body
data.value: The plan collapses into noise. You escape the hunter, but only just. When the fog finally swallows the bridge, the courier is beside you and there is blood running warm beneath your sleeve.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ledger-revealed.Body
data.value: Inside the packet is a coded ledger of dates, payments and names — including people officially declared dead years ago. One entry is fresh. Tonight's date. Your own name is written beside it. The courier points to a place called Grayfen and says one person there can tell you which names are real.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ending-ledger.Body
data.value: You leave the road before dawn with the ledger hidden beneath your coat and no promises made. Somewhere behind you, both the Black Stag and its hunter begin searching for the same missing book. This time, however, you are the one deciding where the trail leads.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.grayfen-road.Body
data.value: By morning the rain has become a cold mist. Grayfen sits between black pines and flooded meadows, its roofs low against the sky. A figure waits on a fallen oak above the road: a wood elf in a moss-dark cloak, bow unstrung but close to hand. She studies you with the patience of someone who has already decided running is pointless.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.isi-first-meeting.Body
data.value: "Isi," she says after you give your name. Her eyes move to the shape of the ledger beneath your coat. "If that book brought you here, then someone has already lied to you. The question is whether it was the Stag, the Crown, or both." She offers to guide you through Grayfen — if you prove you are not another collector of names.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.press-keeper
data.value: Show Mara the flaw and press her for details.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.thank-keeper
data.value: Thank Mara and read the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.leave-keeper
data.value: Stop pushing and read the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.search-for-mark
data.value: Search your memory for the broken-antler mark.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.study-magic
data.value: Test the wax for magical residue.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.go-after-residue
data.value: Take the north road with that thought in mind.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.go-informed
data.value: Keep the memory to yourself and take the north road.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.dive-cover
data.value: Vault the parapet and use the lower maintenance ledge.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.talk-hunter
data.value: "If you wanted the courier dead, you would have struck already."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.take-ledger-clean
data.value: Take the packet and demand the truth.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.take-packet
data.value: Take the packet and run the ledge.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.choose-courier
data.value: Side with the courier and take the packet.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.hear-hunter
data.value: Ask the hunter why the list must disappear.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.take-ledger-warning
data.value: Take the ledger. Decide after you verify it.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.continue-wounded
data.value: Keep moving. Ask what this was all for.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.keep-ledger
data.value: Take the ledger and disappear before either side can reclaim it.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.verify-first
data.value: Go to Grayfen and verify the ledger before trusting anyone.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.follow-stag
data.value: Follow the courier's instructions toward Grayfen.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.go-grayfen
data.value: If your name is on the page, you need answers. Go to Grayfen.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.meet-isi
data.value: Stop where she can see your hands.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.isi-honest
data.value: Show Isi the ledger and tell her exactly how you got it.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.isi-cautious
data.value: Tell her enough to earn a conversation, but keep the ledger hidden.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.isi-threat
data.value: Tell her to move or be moved.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.arthur-vane.Description
data.value: Industrialist. Missing after checking into room 306 at the Hotel Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.evelyn-vane.Description
data.value: Arthur's wife and the person who hired you. She is withholding at least part of the story.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.elias-hale.Description
data.value: City detective who insists Vane is not a police matter while knowing details he was never told.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.vincent-moretti.Description
data.value: Organizer, casino power broker and practical owner of the Ivory Room.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.hotel-mirabelle.Description
data.value: Arthur Vane's last confirmed location. Room 306 is the center of the opening timeline.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.ivory-room.Description
data.value: Invitation-only gaming room above the Monarch Casino.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.key-306.Description
data.value: Hotel duplicate for room 306. The original key was never returned.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.switchboard-log.Description
data.value: The second room-306 call entry was removed cleanly with a blade.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.cufflink.Description
data.value: Recovered beneath the radiator in room 306. The stem was torn sideways under force.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.torn-photo.Description
data.value: Arthur Vane and Vincent Moretti outside the Ivory Room. A third person was deliberately removed.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.lead-where-vane.Description
data.value: The original disappearance. No body, luggage or voluntary departure has been established.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.lead-room-call.Description
data.value: A call exists in the timeline, but its switchboard entry was removed.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.lead-why-ivory.Title
data.value: Why was Vane tied to the Ivory Room?

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.lead-why-ivory.Description
data.value: Arthur claimed he stopped going. The surviving evidence says otherwise.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.theory-evelyn-withholding.Title
data.value: Evelyn is withholding part of Arthur's casino history.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Board.theory-evelyn-withholding.Description

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Subtitle
data.value: Encounter framework test · A short tavern story with real embedded blackjack and Five of a Kind encounters.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.rainy-tavern.Body
data.value: Rain has driven half the road into the Bent Lantern. Near the hearth, a stranger in a charcoal coat sits alone with a deck of cards squared neatly between his hands. Five bone dice rest beside the deck. He has watched you since you entered, but only now does he tap the empty chair opposite him.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.the-offer.Body
data.value: He turns the top card face down without looking at it. "Coin is dull. Information is better. Tonight I only need proof that you know when chance has given you enough. Cards or dice. Your choice. Beat me and the token on this table is yours. Lose, and I take five coins."

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.stakes-explained.Body
data.value: The token is no common tavern marker. A crowned raven has been stamped into one side; the other is smooth from years of handling. The stranger covers it with two fingers. "Win first. Questions are cheaper after victory. Cards or dice; the token does not care."

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.blackjack-table.Body
data.value: The tavern seems to recede as the cards hit the wood. For the next few moments there is only the stranger, the deck and the decision of whether one more card will save you or ruin you.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.five-kind-table.Body
data.value: The deck disappears beneath the stranger's sleeve. Five pale dice take its place. You each get one turn and no more than three throws. A die you trust can stay. When you bank the hand, its strongest real Five of a Kind score becomes the mark to beat.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.push.Body
data.value: The stranger turns both hands over, studies the equal totals and gives a quiet laugh. "The deck dislikes certainty. Again?" He leaves the token where it is.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.dice-push.Body
data.value: For a moment the stranger simply looks from your dice to his. Then one corner of his mouth moves. "Equal marks. The bones have a sense of humor. Again?"

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.ending-win.Body
data.value: The stranger stares at the final cards, then slides the black iron token across the table. "Keep it. If someone shows you the same raven and asks where you earned yours, tell them the Bent Lantern. Nothing more." By the time you look up from the token, his chair is empty.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.ending-loss.Body
data.value: He collects five coins with no triumph in his expression. "You played the cards honestly. That's rarer than winning." The black token disappears beneath his coat, and he returns to his drink as though the wager never happened.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.ending-dice-win.Body
data.value: Your final dice stop moving. The stranger studies the score, then the pattern on the table, and pushes the raven token to you with one finger. "Chance is only noise until someone knows what to keep." When the next burst of tavern laughter turns your head, his chair is empty.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.ending-dice-loss.Body
data.value: The stranger's final die settles and leaves his mark above yours. He takes five coins, gathers the bone dice and nods once. "You kept the right ones. The wrong ones simply answered louder." The raven token vanishes beneath his coat.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Scene.ending-walk-away.Body
data.value: You leave the stranger to his cards and bone dice. Behind you, something rattles across wood and someone else takes the empty chair. Whatever the black token meant, it remains their problem tonight.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.take-seat
data.value: Take the empty seat opposite the stranger.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.ignore-stranger
data.value: Keep your drink, keep your distance and leave him to his games.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.accept-now
data.value: Choose the cards. Play one hand of blackjack.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.choose-dice
data.value: Choose the bone dice. Three throws, best scored hand.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.ask-stakes
data.value: Ask why the black iron token matters.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.decline
data.value: Decline. Some games cost more than their stakes.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.dice-informed
data.value: Take the five bone dice instead.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.leave-informed
data.value: Leave the token and the stranger behind.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.switch-to-dice
data.value: Let the cards rest. Settle it with the dice instead.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.leave-push
data.value: Call the push fair and walk away.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.switch-to-cards
data.value: Change the wager. Deal the cards.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Choice.leave-dice-push
data.value: Accept the draw and leave the table.

data.name: Adventure.strangers-wager.Item.black-iron-token.Description
data.value: A heavy raven-stamped token won from the Ashen Stranger.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.isi-sees-lie.Body
data.value: Isi lets the silence sit until it becomes uncomfortable. "You are either lying, frightened, or both. I can work with frightened. Liars cost more." She steps off the log and starts toward the trees without checking whether you follow.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.isi-camp.Body
data.value: Isi's camp is little more than a lean-to, a smokeless fire and a map scratched onto treated hide. Three places are circled: an abandoned mill, Saint Orra's chapel, and Grayfen market. "People vanished from all three trails," she says. "Find two truths that agree and I'll show you where the Black Stag used to meet."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.grayfen-hub.Body
data.value: From Isi's camp, three trails split through the settlement. The mill road follows the river. The chapel path climbs through old graves. The market lies downhill where smoke and wet wool turn the air sour. Isi watches which direction you choose first.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.mill-yard.Body
data.value: The wheel no longer turns, though the river still pushes against it. Fresh boot marks cross the rotten yard. Someone has nailed a royal tax notice over an older door carved with a shallow stag motif.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.mill-fall.Body
data.value: The frame gives before the lock does. You hit the floor hard enough to drive the breath from your lungs, and a nail tears your palm on the way down.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.mill-front-door.Body
data.value: Dust lies thick over the millstones, but the office has been used recently. A locked drawer sits beneath a desk, and a coil of serviceable rope hangs from a wall peg.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.mill-hidden-door.Body
data.value: The tracks end at a disguised door behind the wheelhouse. Inside is a narrow records room. On a hook hangs a brass key stamped with Saint Orra's crest. A purse of loose coins sits beside it, untouched.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.mill-drawer.Body
data.value: The drawer yields to patience more easily than force. Inside are delivery slips bearing dates that match the ledger. Several shipments were redirected not to a warehouse, but to Saint Orra's old hospice outside town.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.mill-records.Body
data.value: The records are mundane enough to be convincing: grain, lamp oil, linen, medicine. But the quantities are too large for an abandoned hospice. Someone has been provisioning people there for years.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.chapel-gate.Body
data.value: The chapel smells of wet stone and extinguished candles. Its bell rope has been cut. Every grave in the yard faces east except one, which faces the forest. Isi notices it at the same moment you do.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.chapel-altar.Body
data.value: The altar has been moved recently. Beneath it, a cavity holds old bandages, dried herbs and a stoppered green vial. When you lift the vial, a needle hidden in the stone clicks beneath your thumb.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.chapel-poisoned.Body
data.value: The needle barely breaks skin, but the numbness comes too quickly. Isi swears under her breath and catches your wrist before you can rub the wound.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.chapel-crypt.Body
data.value: The grave marker is a false lid over narrow steps. Below, the crypt wall carries hundreds of tiny carved names. Several match the ledger. At the center is the broken-antler stag — carved into stone older than the chapel itself.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.chapel-rubbing.Body
data.value: The chapel records confirm that many of the supposedly dead names passed through Saint Orra's care. Some were refugees. Some were witnesses. Some were children. The Black Stag did not merely carry testimony; it moved people beyond the Crown's reach.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.market-square.Body
data.value: Grayfen's market is a strip of canvas roofs, smoked fish and guarded conversations. Isi points out three useful people: an apothecary who asks no names, a fence who sells information by the sentence, and a royal clerk drinking alone before noon.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.market-apothecary.Body
data.value: Shelves of dark bottles climb to the ceiling. The apothecary recognizes the blood on your clothes without comment. "Six coins for red. Five for green. Rope is not my trade, but the chandlery two doors down has some."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.market-fence.Body
data.value: The fence calls himself Pell and never looks directly at the ledger. He does recognize the copied seal sketched in its margin. "Royal supply office, east archive. They stopped using that stamp after a clerk vanished." He wants five coins for the clerk's name.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.market-clerk.Body
data.value: The royal clerk keeps rubbing a pale line around his wrist where a manacle once sat. He is not drinking from boredom. He is drinking because he recognizes Isi and hopes she has not recognized him.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.market-clue.Body
data.value: Every version of the story points toward the same place: the Crown's east archive supplied the hospice, copied the seal and altered death records. Someone inside the bureaucracy did not merely hunt the Black Stag. They helped manufacture it.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.isi-connects-clues.Body
data.value: Isi lays your evidence beside the ledger. The mill supplied the hospice. The chapel hid witnesses. The market points to the royal archive. She taps a faded trail north of Grayfen. "The hospice is still there. If anyone survived the last purge, they are there — or whoever killed them is."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.isi-personal.Body
data.value: Isi stares at the fire for a long time. "Three people from my grove vanished on this road. One returned without a voice. One came back under a different name. The third never came back. I stopped believing lists were only ink after that."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hospice-gate.Body
data.value: The hospice stands in a hollow where the trees refuse to grow straight. Its front doors are chained, but the side service entrance bears the same crest as the brass key from the mill.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hospice-alarm.Body
data.value: A mechanism inside the wall snaps. Somewhere above you a bell rings despite the cut rope at the chapel. Isi's head turns toward the tree line. "We have minutes. Maybe less."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hospice-archive.Body
data.value: The hospice archive is intact. Death certificates are stacked beside new identities, travel permits and payments. The ledger's false entries are marked with a tiny notch at the bottom of each page. There are fewer false names than Edrin claimed — but enough to prove someone planned to use the ledger as a weapon.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hospice-survivor.Body
data.value: A tapping sound leads to a hidden room. Inside waits an elderly human woman with a Black Stag token around her neck. She calls herself Sister Vael. When Isi steps into the light, Vael begins to cry.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.act2-reveal.Body
data.value: Vael confirms the truth: the Black Stag began as a courier network, but became a chain of safe houses for witnesses, deserters and families marked for disappearance. Then someone inside the network began inserting false names. Someone wanted the Crown to answer a crime with a massacre. Vael knows where the surviving Stag council is hiding.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.stag-safehouse.Body
data.value: The refuge is built beneath the roots of an ancient ash tree. No banners hang inside. No uniforms. Only tired people, sealed letters and weapons kept within reach. The broken-antler sigil is carved above a stone door that predates every beam in the room.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.stag-council.Body
data.value: Three people speak for the refuge: Vael's former captain Seran, a young courier named Lio, and Archivist Merrow — the same name hidden in several royal supply records. Merrow argues that exposing the Crown now will save thousands. Seran insists the planted names will turn justice into slaughter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.merrow-answer.Body
data.value: Merrow does not deny it. He worked inside the east archive for twelve years, forging deaths to save people the Crown meant to erase. "Every false death bought a real life." When you ask about the planted names, his calm finally cracks. "I did not add them. But I know who could."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.seran-answer.Body
data.value: Seran tells you Edrin Vale was once Black Stag. He left after a rescue became an execution. Since then he has hunted both royal agents and Stag extremists. "He thinks burning the network is the only way to stop us becoming what we fought."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.isi-confession.Body
data.value: Isi waits until the council cannot hear. "The third person from my grove was my brother. His death certificate is in Merrow's handwriting. I came here to learn whether that means he was saved, murdered, or turned into a useful lie." She meets your eyes. "If I ask you to choose him over the ledger, I need to know what kind of person will answer."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.truth-fractured.Body
data.value: Merrow reveals that a second ledger exists in the Crown's east archive. The public ledger records deaths. The hidden one records who ordered them. Someone copied pieces of both to create the book in your possession. To prove anything, you need the original seal matrix kept behind the refuge's ancient stone door and the royal ledger in the capital.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.antler-vault.Body
data.value: The stone door has no lock. When you touch the broken-antler carving, the chamber answers with a pulse of cold that is not air. For a moment you see a stag moving between trees that have been dead for centuries. Isi sees it too.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.vault-marked.Body
data.value: The vision breaks with the sensation of antlers scraping across the inside of your skull. A black branchlike mark appears beneath the skin of your wrist. It does not hurt. That is worse.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.vault-vision.Body
data.value: The vision is not a memory you recognize. People in ancient clothing kneel beside a wounded stag while soldiers burn a village beyond the trees. Someone whispers a promise: names will be carried where kings cannot reach. The symbol predates the courier network by far more than centuries of bureaucracy can explain.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.vault-seal.Body
data.value: Inside a cedar box lies the original metal seal matrix. Its broken antler is crisp, nothing like the doubled copy on your letter. Beside it is a royal counterseal impression from the east archive.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.hunter-return.Body
data.value: Edrin Vale arrives before you can leave. This time his sword remains sheathed. He drops a bloodstained royal dispatch on the council table. "They know the hospice was opened. Hunters are already on the road. Decide what you believe while you still have a refuge to believe it in."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.edrin-plan.Title
data.value: Burn the Trail, Save the Names

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.edrin-plan.Body
data.value: Edrin wants to abandon the refuge, scatter the witnesses and enter the capital through forgotten aqueduct tunnels. He does not care whether the Black Stag survives as an organization. "People matter. Symbols don't."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.refuge-evacuation.Body
data.value: Seran orders every letter burned and every witness divided into groups of four. You help hide names inside ordinary trade manifests. By dusk, the refuge looks abandoned enough to fool anyone who does not know where to look.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.isi-route.Body
data.value: Isi chooses neither plan. She knows an old Ashgrove trail that crosses the ravine above the royal road. It is slower, but it avoids the checkpoints and passes near the place her brother was last seen.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ash-road.Body
data.value: The forest changes after sundown. Birds stop calling. Twice, Isi finds boot prints where none should be. The royal hunters are not following your trail; they are moving ahead of it.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ambush-success.Body
data.value: Your ambush catches two royal scouts without raising an alarm. One carries orders signed by the east archive. The other carries a vial of black poison and a map marking a prison wagon headed toward the capital.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ambush-failure.Body
data.value: A crossbow snaps from the dark. The bolt only grazes you, but the wound burns immediately. Isi breaks the shaft and smells the metal. "Poison. Move."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ravine.Body
data.value: The Ashgrove trail ends at a ravine where the old rope bridge has been cut. The opposite ledge is close enough to tempt you and far enough to kill you. Below, lanterns move through the trees: hunters.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ravine-fall.Body
data.value: The descent becomes a fall. You stop hard against wet stone. Isi reaches you seconds later, furious and relieved in equal measure.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.prison-road.Body
data.value: Near midnight you find the prison wagon. Through a barred slit, a wood elf raises his head when Isi whispers a childhood name. Her brother is alive. He is thinner than memory and wearing the uniform of a royal archivist.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.wagon-rescue.Body
data.value: The rescue is quick only because Isi has imagined it for years. Her brother, Cael, can barely stand, but he knows the archive. He forged some of the false deaths himself under threat. He also knows which official ordered the planted names: Chancellor Orven, keeper of the east archive.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.wagon-follow.Body
data.value: You follow at a distance until the wagon passes through an archive service gate. Isi says nothing for most of the journey. When she finally does, her voice is flat. "If he dies in there, I need you to understand that I will remember whose plan this was."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.city-gates.Body
data.value: The capital rises through rain and chimney smoke, all towers and watchfires. The east archive is built into the old palace wall. Somewhere inside are the original ledger, the seal records and perhaps the only proof strong enough to survive daylight.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.archive-captured.Body
data.value: The aqueduct exit is watched. You wake with your wrists bound beneath an archive stairwell. Isi is somewhere beyond the door, arguing with a guard in a language you do not recognize.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.archive-entry.Body
data.value: Rows of shelves vanish into darkness beneath the palace. Every shelf is a weapon disguised as paperwork: births, debts, pardons, deaths. Isi points to a locked iron door marked with the same office crest as your copied seal.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.archive-fight.Body
data.value: The record keeper shouts before the lock gives. Guards flood the aisle. The fight is too close for clean movement; shelves topple, papers ignite and someone drives you to the floor.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.archive-vault.Body
data.value: The hidden ledger is exactly where Cael said it would be. It records not only disappearances, but the people who paid for them. Judges. Officers. Merchants. Chancellor Orven. And beneath several older entries, a symbol drawn in ink instead of stamped: the intact stag, both antlers whole.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.orven-arrives.Body
data.value: Orven enters without guards. He is older than you expected and completely unsurprised to see the Black Stag ledger in your hands. "You think this is corruption," he says. "It is containment. Every generation discovers that names can topple kingdoms. Every generation needs someone willing to decide which names survive."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.whole-stag.Title
data.value: The Antler That Was Never Broken

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.whole-stag.Body
data.value: Orven looks at the intact stag and, for the first time, loses control of his expression. "That mark predates the Crown. We did not create the Stag. We broke its antler because people fear a wounded symbol less than a whole one." Isi's hand closes around her Ashgrove charm.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.orven-offer.Title
data.value: A Quiet Place at the Table

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.orven-offer.Body
data.value: Orven offers you a place inside the archive. Not gold. Not rank. Access. The power to erase a hunted child's name, expose a murderer, or bury a war before it starts. "Someone will choose. Better someone who has seen the cost."

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.final-choice.Body
data.value: You have enough truth to ruin people, save people, or do both badly. Isi stands beside you, silent. Somewhere below, bells begin to ring. There is no clean ending left — only the one you are willing to own.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ending-crown-exposed.Body
data.value: Copies of the verified ledger reach temples, guilds and foreign courts before sunrise. The Crown calls them forgeries until three judges flee the city in the same hour. The Black Stag becomes a symbol again, but not one anyone fully controls. Isi returns to Grayfen carrying names that are finally allowed to belong to the living.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ending-stag.Body
data.value: You destroy every planted name and preserve the routes that hid real witnesses. The network loses its council, its refuge and most of its certainty, but not its purpose. Months later, a letter arrives with no seal. Inside is a single line in Isi's hand: STILL CARRYING THEM.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ending-missing-return.Body
data.value: You do not give the city a scandal. You give families doors opening at midnight, old names returned, new names protected and people thought dead walking home. It is slower than justice and less satisfying than revenge. Isi calls it the first honest thing anyone has done with the ledger.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ending-ashes.Body
data.value: The two ledgers burn together. By morning, neither the Crown nor the Black Stag can prove who belonged to whom. Some monsters escape judgment. Some innocent people escape a purge. History will call it cowardice, mercy or sabotage depending on who gets to write first.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ending-quiet-lie.Body
data.value: You hide the true ledger where neither faction can reach it and allow the public record to stand. The disappearances remain rumors. The network fractures. The Crown survives. You keep the names because somebody must — and discover that carrying a secret can resemble serving it.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.ending-watchful.Body
data.value: You accept Orven's key, but not his certainty. From inside the archive you begin changing small things: a warrant delayed, a child erased from a hunter's list, a corrupt official's sealed file copied twice. Whether you joined the machine or infected it will depend on what you become next.
